project.name: Leaffliction [cite: 1]
project.goal: Image classification by disease recognition on leaves [cite: 3]

general_rules.language: Free to use any language, but Python is advised [cite: 51]
general_rules.norm: If done in Python, it must respect the norm (flake8) [cite: 51]
general_rules.stability_requirement: Functions should not quit unexpectedly (segmentation fault, bus error, double free, etc.)[cite: 42]. If this happens, the project will receive a 0 [cite: 43]

mandatory_parts.title: Analysis of the Data Set [cite: 59]
mandatory_parts.input: Takes as arguments a directory and fetches images in its subdirectories [cite: 60]
tasks: Extract and analyze/understand the data set from the images [cite: 61]
Prompt pie charts and bar charts for each plant type [cite: 61]
Retrieve the name of the directory to name the chart's colones accordingly [cite: 61]

mandatory_parts.title: Data augmentation [cite: 78]
mandatory_parts.context: The data set is not balanced [cite: 79]
mandatory_parts.goal: Balance the number of images for each variety and disease [cite: 80]
output_requirements: Display 6 types of data augmentation for each image given [cite: 88]
Save images with the original file name followed by the name of the type of augmentation [cite: 88]
Return this data set in an 'augmented_directory' for evaluation [cite: 102]

mandatory_parts.title: Image Transformation [cite: 106]
mandatory_parts.recommendation: Choose a language with a library that facilitates image-processing workflow like plantCV [cite: 107]
mandatory_parts.tasks: Implement different methods of direct extraction of characteristics from an image of a leaf [cite: 108]

behavior.single_image_input: Display at least 6 image transformations [cite: 109] and a Color histogram [cite: 184]
behavior.directory_input: Save all the image transformations in the specified destination directory [cite: 186]

programs.name: train.[extension] [cite: 198]
programs.input: Takes as parameter a directory and fetches images in its subdirectories [cite: 199]
tasks: Increase/modify images to learn the characteristics of the diseases [cite: 200]
Learnings must be saved and returned in a zip that also includes your increased/modified images [cite: 201]

programs.name: predict.[extension] [cite: 212]
programs.input: Takes as arguments a path to an image from your learnings [cite: 210]
output: Displays the original image and the transformed image [cite: 210]
Gives the type of disease specified in the leaf [cite: 210]

validation_requirements.split: Separate data set in two parts, one for Training and one for Validation [cite: 215]
validation_requirements.accuracy_target: Predictions of validation set must have an accuracy above 90% [cite: 216]
validation_requirements.minimum_validation_images: Minimum of 100 images in the validation set [cite: 216]

turn_in_and_evaluation.repository: Turn your work in using your GiT repository [cite: 224]
turn_in_and_evaluation.allowed_files: Only your programs and the signature.txt must be present in your repository [cite: 225]
turn_in_and_evaluation.forbidden_files: It is FORBIDDEN to turn in your data set in your Git repository [cite: 237]

signature_txt_file.description: A hash of your DB which includes everything you need to run your programs correctly (dataset in sha1 format and training of your model) [cite: 227]
signature_txt_file.consequence_if_mismatch: During the defense, if the signature of the signature.txt file is not identical to your data set, your grade will be 0 [cite: 238, 239]
